comments.text: The water engineering facts really stood out to me. Recycling nearly 90% of wastewater and turning seawater into drinking water shows how much innovation can come from having very limited natural resources. Geography can be a challenge, but it can also drive some incredible solutions.

comments.author: @SonjaDodd
comments.text: What surprised me most is how much of Israel's story revolves around water. Turning seawater into drinking water and recycling so much wastewater is genuinely impressive. It's fascinating how geography can push a country to come up with such creative solutions.
